thread:
maria: FYI apiserver liveness count jumped in eu-west1 after the provisioner reservation tweak at 08:02 UTC. Controller-manager queue depth rising, some GPU pools not reconciling. Anyone on?
jordan: on it. logs?
maria: logs snippet:

kube-apiserver[pid]: E0108 08:05:12.123 handler.go:245] liveness probe failed: context deadline exceeded
controller-manager: I0108 08:05:14 controller.go:98] workqueue: requeue key "gpu-pool/eu-west1" after failed reconcile

liam: saw the same. provisioner metrics show reserved_gpus went negative: reserve: -3 for pool eu-west1/g4dn. That caused attach failures, preemptions + lease renewal spikes.
sre-runbook-bot: ALERT: controlplane-liveness-spike eu-west1 (severity: P2) — apiserver restarts >=3 in 5m.
ekaterina: could be the reservation algorithm subtracting in-flight attach tokens. @liam can you share output of `kubectl -n infra get pods -o wide | grep provisioner` and `kubectl -n kube-system describe configmap provisioner-config`?
liam: outputs:
$ kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=provisioner -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'
provisioner-0 provisioner-1 provisioner-2

$ kubectl -n infra exec provisioner-0 -- cat /etc/provisioner/config.yaml
reserve: 2
burst: 10
allocation_mode: optimistic

maria: we flipped allocation_mode to optimistic to reduce cold-starts. Looks like optimistic path failed under sustained watch events and double-decrement bug in attach path.
jordan: workaround: flip back to conservative and restart provisioner pods one at a time. Also bump controller-manager leaseRenewDeadline by 5s? risk jitter though.
ekaterina: agree. plan: 1) set allocation_mode=conservative; 2) rollout provisioner (rolling restart) 3) monitor apiserver liveness and controller queue. If no improvement, temporarily route traffic to eu-west2 fallback pools. @sre-runbook-bot please create postmortem ticket.
sre-runbook-bot: Created: INC-2026 controlplane-lease-entropy-eu-west1. Assigned to infra-oncall.
liam: cost note: routing to eu-west2 increases egress and GPU spot premiums ~12% for affected customers; communicate to support.
maria: doing the config change now. I'll post progress.
maria: changed config, rolling restart started (provisioner-0 -> provisioner-1 -> provisioner-2). apiserver liveness back to normal after second pod restart :tada:
jordan: keep an eye for flaps, but this looks like fix. Add a unit test for double-decrement in attach logic.
maria: will open PR for fix + postmortem in docs.
